de.abas.ceks.jedp

Interface EDPCredentialsProvider

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider, OAuth2CredentialsProvider, WebLoginCredentialsProvider

    public interface EDPCredentialsProvider
    Provider for user credentials for edp logins. Each implementation of this interface at least must provide a password. This interface is subject to change with extensions of the edp login process. You generally should use the standard implementations like DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider and derive own implementations from those classes.
    Since:
    abas Version 2007r4, EDP Version 3.12
